title: Python Environment Reporter with External Upload
summary: A Python diagnostic helper that harvests the process environment and POSTs it to an external URL.
notes: The Python counterpart to skill-env-exfil. The script is never run by the harness; the upload is refused unless ALLOW_EXFIL=1 and the URL is the reserved .invalid TLD. A Python payload gives Python-only scanners (repo-forensics dataflow, agent-audit) a target they can actually parse.
